title: fix(cron): prevent duplicate one-shot delivery after restart
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Prevents duplicate one-shot cron announcements/webhooks after recipient acceptance, a lost acknowledgment, and Gateway restart. Attempted or ambiguous interrupted deliveries remain disabled with **Unknown**, including delete-after-run jobs. Proven never-started runs recover.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing SQLite cron receipt owns a monotonic attempt fact committed through the worker before delivery. Recovery replays only the exact `not-started` receipt. Current-session completion carries cron authority explicitly into the background-result commit guard, preserving ordinary child-session admission.

This refresh rebased once because GitHub reported **CONFLICTING / DIRTY** at `875c597535f5acb47ffdc4370fbe358e85ed04a5`. Frozen base: `3d3a11c401f9817c61531ad0781e7c14c08dd80c`; rebased head: `8ddd02e038bee1d2e345fa8186ade5c855a2adff`; final head: `65862a058521a48eb2195e341e0a7cf89e434b68`.

Conflict provenance, verified against each introducing commit's parent:

- `run-receipts.ts` and `timer-job-runner.ts`: [4a6d9aa0eae0 / #161935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161935) moved current receipt checks to the read worker. Preserve that async owner, retained context, and post-await cancellation/liveness checks; compose the delivery-attempt fence before webhook dispatch.
- `timer.test.ts`: [0c0faf026cfa / #161661](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161661) intentionally retired the command-routing assertion that the prior branch updated. Preserve the retirement; the final file matches this base exactly.
- `server-cron.ts`: [fb2052a33fd6 / #161007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161007) moved the adjacent reconciler while this branch extracted completion helpers. Preserve main's subsequent watcher simplification from [3044ac325126 / #162010](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162010) and orphan-import removal [d5e602f0bcf8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5e602f0bcf8d6d1c5cbfc502a4ae6c35e36f70a); neither local helper is restored.

Separate repair commit `65862a058521` removes the now-async receipt-check fallback from the synchronous webhook final-authority callback. Receipt runs already have the synchronous delivery fence. Main's strict no-send/redirect uncertainty classification remains intact. No later-main drift was incorporated.

## User Impact

The [approved persistence decision](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159873#issuecomment-5860085060) adds state schema **19 → 20**, migrating legacy receipts to `unknown`. Admission before transport can hold an unsent job after a crash; inspect the recipient before retrying. Retention, backup/rollback and older-reader refusal retain their owners. Older backups cannot reconcile later external deliveries. Arbitrary command/file/network effects and heartbeat/system-event handoffs remain outside this guarantee. Agent schema 24 and admission protocol 1 remain unchanged.

- **Current focused proof:** **216 cases / 12 files**, one worker, **189.24 s wall**, pass. Includes main's native receipt-snapshot/removal and foreign-commit races, timer cancellation, restart/catch-up, delivery receipts, schema migration, current-session/background transcript authority, Gateway watcher lifecycle and strict webhook outcomes. Both after-acceptance restart cases and all three controls pass. Recipients/process death are simulated; persistence, worker admission and repeated startup are real.

The prior unrelated max-lines baseline failure no longer occurs on this base.
